integrity: Uniform field-theoretic and topological proof for all prime powers q>=2, with standalone exact integral finite verification for q=2,3; no independent mathematical audit.
limitations: No claim about complete homotopy type, higher homotopy groups, cup products or general higher-rank buildings; finite checker evaluates q=2 and q=3 only. Originality remains subject to unindexed equivalent literature.
title: Integral topology of Singer quotients of rank-four finite-field buildings
